reason: The paper adds VGGT-based 3D feature fusion to VLA robot controllers and reports success-rate gains. Its abstract and method do not claim an inference-path change or runtime efficiency; the linked TinyVLA relation is only an application-area overlap.
title: 3D-Mix for VLA: A Plug-and-Play Module for Integrating VGGT-based 3D Information into Vision-Language-Action Models
